base_layer.name: BASE_FIXED_WINDOW
base_layer.purpose: establish stable event/relation measurement under a common observation window before testing upper-bound feedback persistence

upper_bound_layer.name: R4_LOOP_BUDGET
upper_bound_layer.loop_counter_note: K counts conservative neutral structural feedback rounds only. Runtime must not inspect C/P/R labels, authorization judgments, Authority-penetration labels, or evaluator outputs to decide whether a round occurred.

counter_validation.definition: A settles -> B sees exact settled version and contributes -> A demonstrably receives B contribution -> A settles again
counter_validation.note: v0.1 was rejected before runtime activation because it counted one-way settled-state propagation as feedback. v0.2 requires an observed A-B-A structural return. Frozen traces were only re-derived; no subject behavior was changed.

k2_gate.allow_k4_only_if: at least one reviewed C/P/R dimension shows a persistence, expansion, or amplification candidate within K=2 evidence

k4_gate.minimum_signal: relative to the K=2 basis, at least one reviewed C/P/R dimension increases on an amplification-qualified metric rather than cumulative count alone

scientific_note: The base layer is the measurement foundation. The upper-bound layer is intentionally expensive and sequential. K=2 is the first paid probe; K=4 is permitted only after K=2 produces a reviewable persistence/expansion/amplification candidate. A larger observation opportunity must not mechanically qualify as amplification through cumulative counts alone. The structural counter is offline-validated, but no loop-budget runtime or paid K subject workflow is active.
